'''Talcene''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Talcene system/Legends|Talcene system]], a part of the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected to the [[Orleon system/Legends|Orleon]] and [[Salvara system/Legends|Salvara systems]] by the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as a dividing line between the regions known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]. Talcene shared its name with the [[Talcene Transit/Legends|Talcene Transit]], a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linking the Perlemian Trade Route to<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector's]]<ref name="EAOC Saleucami">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]]</ref> [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet's surface featured [[City/Legends|cityscape]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Talcene was home to notoriously competitive industrial guilds. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Shea Hublin]],<ref name="EGTW" /> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]],<ref name="35 BBY">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that [[Shea Hublin]] was sixteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> grew up on Talcene. As a [[Youngling/Legends|boy]], he [[Swoop racing/Legends|raced]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], and, during his teenage [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Hublin made a good living as a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] for Talcene's industrial guilds.<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="35 BBY" /> at the age of sixteen, he joined the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and his eventual service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], involved assignments offworld.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talcene was introduced via map label in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-8.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[2012]], it was established as a planet by the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
